name: token-weather
description: A live forecast of the context window above the prompt, with the 5-hour and 7-day usage windows, the session cost, today's spend and the subagent tally on the same line; buttons, a /weather command and a pane; and optional actions: auto-compact at a threshold, prompt guards on the rate window or a cost cap, a model downshift offer, native notifications and sound.

placement.title: Where the line draws
placement.description: above: the band above the prompt, stacked with other mods' bands and with the buttons (default); below: the hint row under the prompt, the engine's own hint drawn after it

warnTokens.title: Warn from (tokens)
warnTokens.description: Context size at which the token count turns yellow, the ⚠2x long-context tag appears, and a toast fires once

dangerTokens.title: Danger from (tokens)
dangerTokens.description: Context size at which the token count turns red, a second toast fires once, and /compact is suggested after each turn

suggestCompact.title: Suggest /compact in the red zone
suggestCompact.description: After each turn past the danger line, put /compact in the prompt box as the dim suggestion (Tab takes it)

buttons.title: Band buttons
buttons.description: compact, context, cost and clear buttons at the end of the line, or on the row under it when the line is full (ctrl+x tab focuses the band, then c, x, d or n; or click)

showDailyCost.title: Today's and this week's spend
showDailyCost.description: today $X · wk $Y on the line, summed over every session in the plugin's store

showAgents.title: Subagent tally
showAgents.description: agents 1.2M on the line: the tokens the session's subagents, forks and teammates have used

compactAt.title: Compact at (tokens)
compactAt.description: Context size that triggers a compaction after the turn that crossed it; 0 turns it off

compactConfirm.title: Ask before compacting
compactConfirm.description: A Compact / Later question before the compaction compactAt or the compact button triggers

compactFocus.title: Compaction focus
compactFocus.description: What the summary should keep, handed to every compaction this mod triggers and appended to /compact and auto-compaction too

notify.title: Native notifications
notify.description: A system notification (your preferredNotifChannel) on the warn and danger crossings, a usage window reaching rateWarnPercent, and the cost cap's 80% mark

rateWarnPercent.title: Usage window alert (%)
rateWarnPercent.description: Percent of the 5-hour or 7-day window that raises a toast (and the notification or sound when on); 0 turns it off

sound.title: Sound on alerts
sound.description: beep plays a short tone (macOS afplay), speak reads the alert aloud with the system voice

guardRateLimit.title: Hold prompts from (5h %)
guardRateLimit.description: When the 5-hour window is at or past this percent, each prompt you send asks Send / Later first; 0 turns it off

costLimitUsd.title: Session cost cap ($)
costLimitUsd.description: A toast at 80% of the cap; at the cap each prompt asks Send / Later first; 0 turns it off

downshiftModel.title: Downshift to model
downshiftModel.description: A model alias (sonnet, haiku) offered once per session when the weekly window reaches downshiftAt; accepting runs /model; empty turns it off

downshiftAt.title: Downshift at (7d %)
downshiftAt.description: Percent of the 7-day window (or the 5-hour one when there is no weekly window) that raises the downshift offer

pane.title: Open the pane at start
pane.description: Open the weather pane (full history chart, window bars) when the session starts; it needs a terminal of 144 columns or more, /weather pane opens it at any width
